prompt: Then, one winter morning, the road answered..
For three winters I climbed the hill where my sons lay under stone. Eight left me their names. CONstənteen left me his word.
I had asked him to bring her home. I had never asked what it would cost.
Days became weeks. I kept my hands busy; when the hands are still, the heart grows loud. Every sound from the road, I mistook for their return. I waited for nine voices to fill the house again.
Nine mountains away, my daughter was building a life. She did not know that ours had gone silent
